protocol.parent: industry-region mean shrunk to industry mean with pseudo-n500
protocol.age_cell: industry-region-ageband rate shrunk to parent with pseudo-n500
protocol.secondary: unshrunk age cell; missing cell uses parent
protocol.features: Same industry,gu,age bands as fixed candidate
protocol.calibration: Same previous calibration year as candidate; no evaluation labels used for predictions
protocol.scope: All existing96quarters, unchanged cohort and candidate, no tuning

limitations: Post-hoc model comparison; not fresh independent test.
Fixed500 may over-shrink small cells; plain age table reported as sensitivity rather than selecting best per period.
Overlapping horizons/current snapshot/historical completeness limitations remain.
